newsitem.title: USA: Sept S&P futures post new high close at 915.50.
newsitem.headline: Sept S&P futures post new high close at 915.50.

text.p: July 2 - September S&P 500 stock index futures posted a new all-time high settlement of 915.50, ending just below the session high of 916.00, also a record. The rally picked up steam after the close of debt futures, which showed less enthusiasm and ended moderately higher after the FOMC voted to leave short-term interest rates unchanged.
